Tenancy: 12 months Furnish type: Furnished Council Tax: Ask agent PROPERTY TYPE Apartment BEDROOMS 1 BATHROOMS 1 SIZE Ask agent 1 +3 Description Available by Now | Student Welcome Key Features Brand new one-bedroom apartment Offered furnished Private balcony Fully equipped residents’ gym Access to private residents’ club Swimming pool Two private cinema rooms Treatment & massage rooms Private dining and meeting rooms Concierge service Landscaped communal gardens Moments from Westfield White City Under 5 minutes’ walk to White City Station (Central Line, Zone 2) Description An exceptional one-bedroom apartment set within the prestigious White City Living development. The property is offered furnished and benefits from a private balcony and modern, high-quality finishes throughout. Residents enjoy access to outstanding facilities including a fully equipped gym, swimming pool, two cinema rooms, treatment and massage rooms, a therapeutic hydrotherapy pool, as well as private dining and meeting rooms. The development also offers a concierge service and beautifully landscaped communal gardens. Ideally located just moments from Westfield London, providing a wide selection of shops, restaurants and entertainment. White City Underground Station (Central Line, Zone 2) is 2-3 minutes walk away, offering excellent transport links across London. Imperial College London is also within approximately a ten-minute walk, making the apartment ideal for professionals and students alike.
